Q: VSync in pure Java A:

JavaFX is probably the closest official option, because its rendering pulse is designed around frame updates and is generally synchronized with the display refresh cycle.

However, for pure AWT/Java2D, I don’t think there is a portable documented way to access VSync directly. BufferStrategy + Toolkit.sync() is the closest public API, but it does not guarantee real VSync. Anything involving sun.java2d.* flags or ExtendedBufferCapabilities is implementation-specific and not fully portable.

Q: Getting data from World Bank API using pandas A:

There's a very good python package for reading the World Bank's data API and it integrates with pandas. No need to reinvent the wheel. To accomplish what you try to set out above, install the wbgapi package and then do this:

>>> import wbgapi as wb
>>> wb.data.DataFrame('NY.GDP.PCAP.CD', time=2015)
         NY.GDP.PCAP.CD
economy                
ABW        27458.220154
AFE         1498.875240
AFG          565.569730
AFW         1860.727686
AGO         3641.728939
...                 ...

or for specific countries:

>>> wb.data.DataFrame('NY.GDP.PCAP.CD', economy=['USA','CAN','MEX'], time=range(2015,2018))
               YR2015        YR2016        YR2017
economy                                          
CAN      43594.194105  42314.061582  45129.628117
MEX      10021.238612   9097.923977   9649.278168
USA      56572.918900  57638.101837  59635.098440

That's just one of the tips of the iceberg

Q: URLImage.createMaskAdapter() / Image.createMask() fails on iOS with moderately sized masks A:

This does not seem like your code issue, it is due to the iOS specific limitations in codename one.

In order to create runtime mask Codename one uses native core graphics. And this operation are memory heavy task on real iOS devices.

Please note Apple has not mentioned any size limit but looking at the above values it can be determined which you are seeing it as well.

It works in Android and iOS simulator because iOS simulator does not use GPU for rendering only real iOS device does.

As a result large runtime mask fails on iOS.

What you can try to avoid this is use small image mask as you mentioned above which works and let code name one handles scaling internally

Or

Try using rounded image Apis and remove using mask which will prevent this crash.
